facts.fact: Rijul Sharma is Director of Data Analytics and Reporting at StackAdapt, as featured in the company's 'Life in Adtech' blog series.
facts.quote: This month features Rijul Sharma, Director of Data Analytics and Reporting at StackAdapt.
